name: geometry-tactical-right-thales-vision-hounds-local
description: School-safe three-student tactical geometry game with right-triangle-only Thales problems, visible enemy detection cones, contextual weapon throws, fast melee-only hound enemies, fixed 20-minute mission timing, no manual pause and automatic local JSON/CSV results.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-professional-v50.js && node scripts/prepare-advanced-v51.js && node scripts/patch-advanced-v51-readiness.js && node scripts/prepare-ratio-thales-v52.js && node scripts/prepare-right-thales-vision-hounds-v53.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v53/main.js && node --check school-game/v53/preload.js && node --check school-game/v53/game.js && node scripts/right-thales-vision-hounds-v53-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64

build.productName: Geometry Tactical Ratio Thales Vision Local

nsis.shortcutName: Geometry Tactical Ratio Thales Vision Local
nsis.uninstallDisplayName: Geometry Tactical Ratio Thales Vision Local
